cards.title: Size and font
cards.body: `font-size` sets how big text is, often in `px`. `font-family` picks the font, with a backup after a comma.
cards.code: Bigger, fancier text.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: The heading should be much bigger, but nothing changes. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: Sizes need a unit. The browser ignores a bare `30`; write `30px`.

check.question: Which property makes text bigger?
check.explanation: `font-size` is the real property; the others do not exist.

exercise.prompt: Center the `<h1>` with `text-align`, and give paragraphs a `font-size` of `18px`.
